newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Imsa acquires stake in Argentina's Comesi.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Imsa acquires stake in Argentina's Comesi.

text.p: Mexican industrial company Grupo Imsa announced Wednesday the acquisition of 26 percent of Argentine steel maker Comesi SA for $12.6 million.

Monterrey-based Imsa said the acquisition will be made through its subsidiary Imsa Acero and said the deal also included an option to acquire an additional 25 percent of Comesi, which may become effective in the next 12 months.

Imsa makes auto batteries and construction materials and processes steel. Comesi is a pioneer in the coated steel market, specializing in galvanized and prepainted steel with installed capacities of 150,000 and 22,000 tonnes annually.
Comesi is the only producer of Galvalume coated-steel products in South America and in 1996 total revenues reached $116 million, Imsa said.

"We would like to invest in strategic projects concentrating on improving product lines and higher vertical integration of Comesi," Marcelo Canales Clariond, Imsa's CFO was reported as saying in the media release.
